<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Shipping" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/shipping">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Shipping">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Shipping" name="Shipping of goods" processRef="Process_Shipping"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LogisticCompanies" name="Logistic companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invitation" name="Invitation" sourceRef="Task_InviteLogisticCompanies" targetRef="Participant_LogisticCompanies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offers" name="Offers" sourceRef="Participant_LogisticCompanies" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Shipping" name="Shipping of goods" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Shipping">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Secretary" name="Secretary">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Shipping</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ShippingDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_NoShipping</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ClarifyShipper</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AmountSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InviteLogisticCompanies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveOffers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectLogisticCompany</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NormalPostShipment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MethodJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WritePackageLabel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_LogisticsHead" name="Logistics department head">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InsuranceSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeParcelInsurance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InsuranceJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Warehousemen" name="Warehousemen">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PackageGoods</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReadyJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareForPickup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ReadyForPickup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Shipping" name="Goods to be shipped">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ShippingDecision" name="Goods shall be shipped?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DecisionNo</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DecisionYes</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoShipping" name="No shipment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DecisionNo</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Start shipping preparation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DecisionYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToClarify</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToPackage</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ClarifyShipper" name="Clarify who will do the shipping">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToClarify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ClarifyToAmount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AmountSplit" name="Large amount?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ClarifyToAmount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LargeAmount</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SmallAmount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InviteLogisticCompanies" name="Invite three logistic companies to make offers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LargeAmount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InviteToOffers</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive offers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InviteToOffers</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OffersToSelect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectLogisticCompany" name="Select one logistic company">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OffersToSelect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectToMethodJoin</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SmallAmount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PostToMethodJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MethodJoin" name="Shipping method determined">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectToMethodJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PostToMethodJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MethodJoinToLabel</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_WritePackageLabel" name="Write package label">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MethodJoinToLabel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LabelToInsuranceSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsuranceSplit" name="Parcel insurance necessary?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LabelToInsuranceSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsuranceYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsuranceNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeParcelInsurance" name="Take parcel insurance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsuranceYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsuranceToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsuranceJoin" name="Insurance decision done">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsuranceToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsuranceNo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsuranceJoinToReady</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackageGoods" name="Package goods">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToPackage</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PackageToReady</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ReadyJoin" name="Everything ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsuranceJoinToReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PackageToReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReadyToPrepare</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareForPickup" name="Prepare packaged goods for pickup by logistic company">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReadyToPrepare</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PrepareToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReadyForPickup" name="Goods ready for pickup">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrepareToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToDecision" sourceRef="StartEvent_Shipping" targetRef="Gateway_ShippingDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DecisionNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ShippingDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_NoShipping"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DecisionYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ShippingDecision" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToClarify" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_ClarifyShipper"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToPackage" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_PackageGoods"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ClarifyToAmount" sourceRef="Task_ClarifyShipper" targetRef="Gateway_AmountSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LargeAmount" name="Large amount" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountSplit" targetRef="Task_InviteLogisticCompanies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SmallAmount" name="Small amount" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountSplit" targetRef="Task_NormalPostShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InviteToOffers" sourceRef="Task_InviteLogisticCompanies" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OffersToSelect" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_SelectLogisticCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectToMethodJoin" sourceRef="Task_SelectLogisticCompany" targetRef="Gateway_MethodJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostToMethodJoin" sourceRef="Task_NormalPostShipment" targetRef="Gateway_MethodJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MethodJoinToLabel" sourceRef="Gateway_MethodJoin" targetRef="Task_WritePackageLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabelToInsuranceSplit" sourceRef="Task_WritePackageLabel" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceSplit" targetRef="Task_TakeParcelInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceSplit" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceToJoin" sourceRef="Task_TakeParcelInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceJoinToReady" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ReadyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackageToReady" sourceRef="Task_PackageGoods" targetRef="Gateway_ReadyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadyToPrepare" sourceRef="Gateway_ReadyJoin" targetRef="Task_PrepareForPickup"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareToEnd" sourceRef="Task_PrepareForPickup" targetRef="EndEvent_ReadyForPickup"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ShipYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToClarify</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToPackage</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ClarifyShipper" name="Clarify who will do the shipping">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToClarify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ClarifyToAmount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AmountDecision" name="Amount large or small?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ClarifyToAmount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LargeAmount</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SmallAmount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_InviteLogisticCompanies" name="Invite three logistic companies to make offers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LargeAmount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InviteToReceive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive offers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InviteToReceive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveToSelect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectLogisticCompany" name="Select one logistic company">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveToSelect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectToMethodMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_NormalPostShipment" name="Use normal post shipment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SmallAmount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PostToMethodMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MethodMerge" name="Shipping method determined">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectToMethodMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PostToMethodMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MethodMergeToLabelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_LabelInsuranceSplit" name="Parcel insurance needed?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MethodMergeToLabelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToLabel</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToInsurance</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_WritePackageLabel" name="Write package label">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToLabel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LabelToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeParcelInsurance" name="Take parcel insurance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToInsurance</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsuranceToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_LabelInsuranceJoin" name="Label and insurance done">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LabelToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsuranceToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinToReady</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackageGoods" name="Package goods">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToPackage</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PackageToReady</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ReadyJoin" name="Everything ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinToReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PackageToReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReadyToPrepare</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareForPickup" name="Prepare packaged goods for pickup by logistic company">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReadyToPrepare</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PrepareToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReadyForPickup" name="Goods ready for pickup">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrepareToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToShipDecision" sourceRef="StartEvent_GoodsToShip" targetRef="Gateway_ShipDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShipNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_NoShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShipYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipDecision" targetRef="Gateway_PrepareSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToClarify" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareSplit" targetRef="Task_ClarifyShipper"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToPackage" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareSplit" targetRef="Task_PackageGoods"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ClarifyToAmount" sourceRef="Task_ClarifyShipper" targetRef="Gateway_AmountDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LargeAmount" name="Large amount" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountDecision" targetRef="Task_InviteLogisticCompanies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SmallAmount" name="Small amount" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountDecision" targetRef="Task_NormalPostShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InviteToReceive" sourceRef="Task_InviteLogisticCompanies" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveToSelect" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_SelectLogisticCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectToMethodMerge" sourceRef="Task_SelectLogisticCompany" targetRef="Gateway_MethodMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostToMethodMerge" sourceRef="Task_NormalPostShipment" targetRef="Gateway_MethodMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MethodMergeToLabelSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_MethodMerge" targetRef="Gateway_LabelInsuranceSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToLabel" sourceRef="Gateway_LabelInsuranceSplit" targetRef="Task_WritePackageLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToInsurance" name="Parcel insurance necessary" sourceRef="Gateway_LabelInsuranceSplit" targetRef="Task_TakeParcelInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabelToJoin" sourceRef="Task_WritePackageLabel" targetRef="Gateway_LabelInsuranceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceToJoin" sourceRef="Task_TakeParcelInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_LabelInsuranceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToReady" sourceRef="Gateway_LabelInsuranceJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ReadyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackageToReady" sourceRef="Task_PackageGoods" targetRef="Gateway_ReadyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadyToPrepare" sourceRef="Gateway_ReadyJoin" targetRef="Task_PrepareForPickup"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareToEnd" sourceRef="Task_PrepareForPickup" targetRef="EndEvent_ReadyForPickup"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Shipping" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/shipping">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Shipping" name="Shipping of goods" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Shipping">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Secretary" name="Secretary">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_GoodsToShip</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ShippingDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_NoShipping</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ClarifyShipper</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AmountSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InviteLogisticCompanies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveOffers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectLogisticCompany</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NormalPostShipment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MethodMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_LabelInsuranceSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WritePackageLabel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_LogisticsHead" name="Logistics department head">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeParcelInsurance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Warehousemen" name="Warehousemen">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PackageGoods</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_LabelInsuranceJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReadyJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareForPickup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_PackagedGoodsReady</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_GoodsToShip" name="Goods to be shipped">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ShippingDecision" name="Goods shall be shipped?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DecisionNo</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DecisionYes</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoShipping" name="No shipment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DecisionNo</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Start shipping preparation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DecisionYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToClarify</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToPackage</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ClarifyShipper" name="Clarify who will do the shipping">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToClarify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ClarifyToAmount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackageGoods" name="Package goods">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToPackage</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PackageToReady</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AmountSplit" name="Large amount?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ClarifyToAmount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LargeAmount</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SmallAmount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_InviteLogisticCompanies" name="Invite three logistic companies to make offers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LargeAmount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InviteToOffers</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive offers from logistic companies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InviteToOffers</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OffersToSelect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectLogisticCompany" name="Select one logistic company">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OffersToSelect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectToMethodMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_NormalPostShipment" name="Use normal post shipment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SmallAmount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PostToMethodMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MethodMerge" name="Shipping method determined">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectToMethodMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PostToMethodMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MethodMergeToSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_LabelInsuranceSplit" name="Label and insurance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MethodMergeToSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToLabel</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToInsurance</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_WritePackageLabel" name="Write package label">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToLabel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LabelToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeParcelInsurance" name="Take parcel insurance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToInsurance</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsuranceToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_LabelInsuranceJoin" name="Label and insurance done">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LabelToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsuranceToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinToReady</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ReadyJoin" name="Everything ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinToReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PackageToReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReadyToPrepare</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareForPickup" name="Prepare packaged goods for pickup by logistic company">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReadyToPrepare</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PrepareToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PackagedGoodsReady" name="Packaged goods prepared for pickup">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrepareToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToDecision" sourceRef="StartEvent_GoodsToShip" targetRef="Gateway_ShippingDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DecisionNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ShippingDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_NoShipping"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DecisionYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ShippingDecision" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToClarify" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_ClarifyShipper"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToPackage" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_PackageGoods"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ClarifyToAmount" sourceRef="Task_ClarifyShipper" targetRef="Gateway_AmountSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LargeAmount" name="Large amount" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountSplit" targetRef="Task_InviteLogisticCompanies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SmallAmount" name="Small amount" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountSplit" targetRef="Task_NormalPostShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InviteToOffers" sourceRef="Task_InviteLogisticCompanies" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OffersToSelect" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_SelectLogisticCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectToMethodMerge" sourceRef="Task_SelectLogisticCompany" targetRef="Gateway_MethodMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostToMethodMerge" sourceRef="Task_NormalPostShipment" targetRef="Gateway_MethodMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MethodMergeToSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_MethodMerge" targetRef="Gateway_LabelInsuranceSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToLabel" sourceRef="Gateway_LabelInsuranceSplit" targetRef="Task_WritePackageLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToInsurance" name="Parcel insurance necessary" sourceRef="Gateway_LabelInsuranceSplit" targetRef="Task_TakeParcelInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${parcelInsuranceNecessary}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabelToJoin" sourceRef="Task_WritePackageLabel" targetRef="Gateway_LabelInsuranceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceToJoin" sourceRef="Task_TakeParcelInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_LabelInsuranceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToReady" sourceRef="Gateway_LabelInsuranceJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ReadyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackageToReady" sourceRef="Task_PackageGoods" targetRef="Gateway_ReadyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadyToPrepare" sourceRef="Gateway_ReadyJoin" targetRef="Task_PrepareForPickup"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareToEnd" sourceRef="Task_PrepareForPickup" targetRef="EndEvent_PackagedGoodsReady"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states that two or more activities are performed after a step, joined by 'and', where one of them happens only 'if necessary' or under a stated condition while another is always performed, so the set of activities that actually occur varies but is never empty: Model an inclusive split before these activities. Label the outgoing flow of the conditional activity with the stated condition, and leave the always-performed activity's outgoing flow unconditional. Close the activities with a matching inclusive join before the next step. Do not use an exclusive gateway, because both activities can occur together.
rules.situation: the description states that two or more activities are performed after a step, joined by 'and', where one of them happens only 'if necessary' or under a stated condition while another is always performed, so the set of activities that actually occur varies but is never empty

rules.instruction: When the description states that a role takes a decision on whether one or more optional activities are needed, the activities that follow are performed by other roles and may occur together, and they then converge before a later step performed by a role: Model the split as an inclusive gateway placed in the lane of the role that takes the decision, and do not leave it out of the model. Put the conditional activities each in the lane of their performing role, with one flow from the split to each activity labeled with its stated condition. Close them with a matching inclusive join placed in the lane of the role responsible for the step that follows, and connect that join to the next step. Do not move the split or the join into the lane of a role that does not take or carry out that step.
rules.situation: the description states that a role takes a decision on whether one or more optional activities are needed, the activities that follow are performed by other roles and may occur together, and they then converge before a later step performed by a role

rules.instruction: When the description states a sequence of steps in which an activity or start point is followed by a decision on a condition, or by parallel preparation activities, so that the description names what comes after each element: Connect every stated element to the element the description says follows it with a sequence flow. Connect an activity whose result is tested by a later decision directly into that decision gateway. Connect a start event with a sequence flow into the parallel split that starts the parallel branches. Give each conditional branch of a decision a flow to the activity named for that branch. Do not leave a stated activity or gateway without its incoming or outgoing flow when the description gives its successor.
rules.situation: the description states a sequence of steps in which an activity or start point is followed by a decision on a condition, or by parallel preparation activities, so that the description names what comes after each element

rules.instruction: When the description states two alternative methods for the same activity, and the choice between them depends on a stated criterion or threshold (such as an amount or size) that is separate from an earlier yes/no decision about whether the activity happens at all: Model an exclusive (XOR) gateway at the point of choice, with one outgoing flow to each alternative method as its own task. Name the gateway with a question that states the selecting criterion from the description, not a repetition of the earlier decision's question. Route the alternatives into one exclusive merge only if the process continues afterwards.
rules.situation: the description states two alternative methods for the same activity, and the choice between them depends on a stated criterion or threshold (such as an amount or size) that is separate from an earlier yes/no decision about whether the activity happens at all

rules.instruction: When the description says a role asks several outside parties for proposals and then chooses one of them, and the description gives no steps for what those outside parties do: Model the request and the returned proposals as activities in the requesting role's lane, followed by the choice as a decision in that same lane. Do not create a pool for the outside parties, and do not add message flows between this lane and any pool, unless the description states the outside parties' own activities.
rules.situation: the description says a role asks several outside parties for proposals and then chooses one of them, and the description gives no steps for what those outside parties do

rules.instruction: When the description states that each activity is followed by a specific next activity, and that a decision after an activity may send the flow back to repeat an earlier activity before continuing: Connect each stated activity to the activity that the description places immediately after it with a sequence flow. Where a decision may repeat an earlier activity, add an exclusive gateway after that decision with one flow looping back to the repeated activity and one flow continuing to the next stated activity. Do not leave any stated step without an incoming flow from its predecessor or an outgoing flow to its successor, except for the start and end events.
rules.situation: the description states a conditional decision whose condition concerns an activity that runs in parallel with or after the earlier conditional branch (for example, a separate sentence says that some activities are performed 'in the meantime' and a later sentence makes a further decision depend on the result of one of those activities), so the second condition does not follow directly from the activity that precedes the first decision

rules.instruction: When the description states the end result of a process as a completed state, using a passive or 'being ... ed' phrase, and no separate outcome event is named for it: Label the end event with that resulting state, using the noun and participle wording the description gives (for example, 'X ready' or 'X prepared'). Do not restate the result as a new noun phrase or a question.
rules.situation: the description states the end result of a process as a completed state, using a passive or 'being ... ed' phrase, and no separate outcome event is named for it
